title: Traffic Jam

items.label: Narrow Crossing
items.description: Pedestrians squeeze through a narrow opening between slow vehicles.
items.visual_focus: a pedestrian's body squeezed between two slow vehicles, mid-step
items.local_cue: two maroon battery-run easy bikes pressing close on a Rajshahi bazaar road

items.label: Blocked Footpath
items.description: A walker steps into traffic because goods fill the footpath.
items.visual_focus: goods blocking the raised footpath and a pedestrian's foot entering the road
items.local_cue: a Saheb Bazar-style small shop's raised concrete footpath with boxes and a battery-run easy bike at its edge

items.label: Mid-Road Stop
items.description: A driver stops in the moving lane to let a passenger out.
items.visual_focus: a passenger stepping out of a stopped vehicle in front of a waiting vehicle
items.local_cue: a passenger stepping down from a maroon battery-run easy bike beside another waiting easy bike

items.label: Handcart Loading
items.description: A worker loads boxes from a handcart while vehicles wait behind.
items.visual_focus: hands lifting a box onto a handcart while traffic waits directly behind
items.local_cue: a hand-pulled delivery van and stacked cartons outside a narrow Rajshahi shopfront, with a waiting easy bike

items.label: Crowded Curb
items.description: Two vehicles compete for a curb with no clear place to pick up riders.
items.visual_focus: two vehicles pressing toward the same short curb while riders wait
items.local_cue: two battery-run easy bikes converging beside a short concrete bazaar curb

items.label: Rushed Delivery
items.description: A shop worker rushes boxes from a vehicle to a doorway during a busy period.
items.visual_focus: a shop worker hurrying boxes from a delivery vehicle into a doorway
items.local_cue: a shop worker moving cartons from a small local delivery van into a ground-floor bazaar shop

questions: Which two scenes would slow a person on foot most?
When has a crowded Rajshahi street delayed you? What happened?
Should the curb serve passengers or shop deliveries first? Why?
Why might a driver stop in the lane even when it delays others?
If loading is banned at busy times, who might lose income?
You have 300,000 BDT and 30 days. What one street-space change would your grant test?

grant.pilot_scope: Pilot one safer pickup or delivery zone on a short Saheb Bazar segment.
